intro_html: Filipino comfort in a bowl: chicken thighs braised in a tomato sauce with potatoes, carrots, bell peppers, and peas, seasoned the traditional way with fish sauce. Each serving lands 57 grams of protein at 675 calories for about $3.91 (at everyday cost). The potatoes cook in the stew, so the starch is built right in.
cost_closing_html: About $3.91 a bowl (at everyday cost) for chicken afritada. Filipino turo-turo plates run $12 to $15 where you can find them, and in most of the Midwest you cannot, which makes your version priceless and also $3.91.
shop_smart: Chicken thighs carry the dish at $18.37 for 7.5 pounds, about $2.45 a pound. The clamp on this recipe keeps portions honest at a still-huge 57 grams of protein.
The tomato base is the other big line at $20.15 in canned diced tomatoes. Store-brand cans are the move, and if crushed tomatoes are cheaper that week they work the same here.
A splash of fish sauce is the authentic secret and costs 61 cents worth per batch. The bottle lasts a year of Filipino and Thai recipes.
make_it: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Cut the chicken thighs into large chunks and pat dry. Brown them in batches in some of the vegetable oil in your big pot. Set aside.
Fry the diced potatoes and carrots in the remaining oil 5 minutes until they pick up color. Set aside with the chicken.
Saute the diced onion until soft, then the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes and fish sauce, bring to a simmer, and cook 10 minutes to concentrate.
Return the chicken, potatoes, and carrots. Cover and simmer 20 to 25 minutes until the chicken reads 165 F and the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the sliced green and red bell peppers and the peas for the last 5 minutes so they keep some snap. Season with black pepper and salt to taste.
Portion into 14 containers, distributing chicken and vegetables evenly.
portion_html: Weigh the finished pot, subtract the empty pot weight you wrote down, and divide by 14. Scale that into each container. Each bowl comes in at about 675 calories with 57 grams of protein.

steps: Brown chunked chicken thighs, then fry the potatoes and carrots.
Saute onion and garlic, then simmer the diced tomatoes with fish sauce.
Return chicken and vegetables and braise to 165 F until tender.
Add bell peppers and peas for the last 5 minutes.
